text: Garamond Court in Don Mills is home of the much loved Japanese Canadian Cultural Centre. Founded in 1963, the Japanese Canadian Cultural Centre is a not-for-profit organization which celebrates the unique culture, history and legacy of Japanese Canadians for the benefit of all Canadians. The Japanese Canadian Cultural Centre is recognized worldwide as an important and vibrant community institution. With 5,200 members, almost half of which are of non-Japanese ancestry, the centre attracts over 210,000 visitors to its festivals, concerts, martial arts tournaments and special events annually. It welcomes more than 15,000 students from the Greater Toronto Area and beyond each year to participate in seminars on Japanese history, culture and the Japanese Canadian experience.
